name: Rotarod
description: The animal walks on a rotating rod, at a fixed or accelerating speed, until it falls. Measures motor coordination, balance and motor learning.

parameters.label: Accelerating rod
parameters.help: On: the rod speeds up from the start speed to the end speed. Off: the rod turns at the start speed for the whole trial.

parameters.label: Rod start speed
parameters.help: Rotation speed of the rod when the trial starts.

parameters.label: Rod end speed
parameters.help: Rotation speed the rod reaches at the end of the acceleration and then keeps. Must not be below the start speed.

parameters.label: Acceleration time
parameters.help: Time the rod takes to go from the start speed to the end speed.

parameters.label: Trial cut-off
parameters.help: The trial ends at this time. An animal still on the rod gets this value as its latency to fall.

inputEvents.label: Fall
inputEvents.definition: The subject falls or passively rotates a full turn.

metrics.label: Latency to fall
metrics.description: Time the animal stayed on the rod. Longer latencies indicate better motor coordination.
metrics.definition: Fall time; without a fall by the cut-off, the latency is censored at max_trial_duration_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Fall detected
metrics.description: Whether the animal fell before the trial cut-off.
metrics.definition: 1 when a fall occurs by the cut-off, 0 when the whole trial was recorded without one.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Speed at fall
metrics.description: Rod speed at the moment the animal fell. Higher speeds indicate better performance on an accelerating rod.
metrics.definition: Rod speed at the fall time; accelerating linearly from start_rpm to end_rpm, then constant.
metrics.formula: accelerating: start + (end - start) x min(t, acceleration_duration_s) / acceleration_duration_s; fixed: start_rpm
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) without a fall by the cut-off; also missing when not scored or incompletely recorded.
